change: SDK calibration for camera and explicit intrinsics files for offline geometry
configuration_contracts: Camera always selects SDK calibration without numeric overrides
Inference-only offline and recording inputs do not read unused calibration files
Offline and recording point clouds require an explicit intrinsics_file
Relative intrinsics paths use the main pipeline directory independently of working directory
Standalone calibration JSON and recorder metadata.intrinsics are accepted
Missing files, wrong dimensions, incomplete fields, invalid principal points and non-finite values are rejected
Legacy offline/recording inline intrinsics produce migration messages
Recharge-only ROS uses CameraInfo or explicit calibration when its backend needs frame intrinsics
Disabled recharge and the default dataset calibration introduce no new calibration dependency

inference_only_runtime.ros_probe_capture_stamps: deterministic increasing stamps; independent of WSL host clock adjustments

cpu_recording_replay.intrinsics_file: explicit relative path to recording metadata.json

limits: No complete ARM cross build or X5 hardware test for this change
Camera integration uses the deterministic vendor ABI fixture, not a physical camera
CPU regression does not establish Stereo accuracy or X5 performance
SDK algorithm implementation and public C interface were unchanged in this change
